items.title: Library primitives
items.detail: Dated model pricing, cost breakdowns, and deterministic, availability-aware model suggestions are implemented and tested.

items.title: Complexity estimation
items.detail: Versioned pre-launch estimates, historical-neighbour input, an optional host-supplied assessment, and a fixture-based backtest contract are implemented. Production calibration results are not yet published.

items.title: Benchmark harness
items.detail: Versioned setups, isolated workspaces, deterministic evaluation, append-only JSON results, and structured lifecycle events are implemented.

items.title: Quota-cap forecasting
items.detail: The five-hour-cap estimator and admission integration are a reviewed plan only. They require operator approval and validated, privacy-reviewed calibration data.

items.title: First package publish
items.detail: The package is tag-ready; the first NuGet publication remains an operator-controlled publishing step.
